Setting.Name: TESSERA::API::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enables the staged TESSERA external API. Keep disabled until API identities, keys, groups, SupportAssignments, and ContractEntitlements are configured.

Setting.Name: GenericInterface::Operation::Module###TESSERA::Stage
Setting.Description: Registers the entitlement-aware TESSERA staging operation.

Setting.Name: GenericInterface::Operation::Module###TESSERA::Status
Setting.Description: Registers the caller-owned TESSERA staging status operation.

Setting.Name: GenericInterface::Operation::Module###TESSERA::ExecutionCallback
Setting.Description: Authenticates and records asynchronous web service completion callbacks.

Setting.Name: TESSERA::AsyncExecution::Handlers
Setting.Description: Backend-owned asynchronous continuation handlers. Never populate from policy YAML.
